facts.fact: 她反问：你在冒险我怎么可能跑
facts.anchor: “You expected me to run off to another court while you were here, risking your life!”

facts.fact: 她想过若当年她杀了他，后果会更糟
facts.anchor: It would’ve been much worse than participating in a spectacle of games held by the Prince of Carnage
“I suppose so. A wife doesn’t abandon her husband now, does she?”

facts.fact: 他逼她承认：你至少有点喜欢我
facts.anchor: “That must mean you like me, at least a little.”

facts.fact: 私生子继承计划由 Winter 点破
facts.anchor: “The king didn’t only fuck countless women—he fathered a bastard son as most unfaithful males do.”

facts.fact: General Rawling 跪拜：你是我的 alpha
facts.anchor: Rawling knelt before Winter and bowed his head. “You are my alpha.”

facts.fact: 对外口径：守卫杀王、我杀了凶手
facts.anchor: “Tell the pack the guard killed the king and that I slaughtered my father’s killer.”

facts.fact: 他有家后开始懂“家是软肋”
facts.anchor: “And now that I have one, I’m beginning to understand why.”
